This diagram shows:
- The full circle of an analog clock
- Minute markings at each 1-minute interval (60 total)
- Hour numbers 1 through 12
- Both hour and minute hands pointing at 12:00

The minute markings help us understand how time is divided into 60 equal parts in an hour. Each small mark represents one minute, and each number represents 5 minutes (since there are 5 marks between each number).
